publication_scope.include: Every Git-versioned file below the source root is represented by a reader or artifact page and an unchanged raw download.
publication_scope.exclude: Ignored or untracked workstation state, credentials, .env files, and files outside the source root are not corpus material.
publication_scope.metadata_policy: Audience, status, type, confidence, verification, draft, archive, and lifecycle fields are display context only; none are publication filters.

site.title: Freight Trust Knowledge Atlas
site.description: A public, source-derived working record for Freight Trust research, programme design, evidence, drafts, and governance.
